name: Chicken Bacon Ranch Bowl with Roasted Zucchini, Bell Pepper & Mushrooms (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium zucchini squash
1 lb white mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Place spices in a small bowl, then stir to combine the spice mix. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp dill, dried
1 tsp parsley flakes
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half-moons. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the baking sheet with the zucchini.

Halve mushrooms and add to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with oil and sprinkle with half of the spice mix. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve remaining spice mix for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add mayo and vinegar to the bowl with the reserved spice mix. Whisk to combine the ranch dressing. Add water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mayonnaise
2 tsp white wine vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 3-4 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)

While the bacon is cooking, separate toast slices and arrange on another baking sheet. Add to the oven and bake until golden and toasted, 5-7 minutes. Remove from oven, slice crosswise into 1-inch strips, and set aside.
Meanwhile, cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the bacon is done, return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide 1 cup of chicken and 1 ½ cups of roasted veggies between plates, separating the different foods, if desired. Serve with cheesy toast. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining veggies and chicken between plates or bowls. Top with crispy bacon, drizzle with ranch, and enjoy!
